title: React Native Developer
description:
Our Client is one of largest TV providers in North America and we are searching for a Senior Software Developer to join our team. The project focuses on developing mobile application for video streaming platform.


Responsibilities:

  • You will be implementing new features and enhancing existing functionalities on client applications to support streaming video products. This includes estimation, design, development, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with other software engineers, product managers, and architects in a cross functional environment to ensure functions and performance meet customer requirements in a cost effective and maintainable way.
  • Provide on-call support including monitoring, triaging and resolving production issues


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Proficient in JavaScript and React Native mobile app development (5+ years) as well as at least one of the following: Java/Kotlin or Obj-C/Swift
  • Streaming mobile app development experience with iOS/Android and TV Platforms
  • Strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams
  • Experience with agile development
  • Good verbal/written communications skills

title: DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Buscamos um(a) DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior para atuar na operação e evolução de uma plataforma baseada em microserviços, com foco em automação, confiabilidade e entrega contínua em ambiente multi-cloud (Azure + AWS).


Responsabilidades

  • Operar e evoluir clusters Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) com GitOps (Argo CD), garantindo padrões de deploy, rollback e controles por ambiente.
  • Manter e melhorar pipelines CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions) com pipelines-as-code em YAML.
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e empacotamento/deploy com Helm (charts e padrões).
  • Evoluir observabilidade (métricas, logs, alertas e dashboards) e apoiar troubleshooting ponta a ponta.
  • Atuar em incidentes, análises pós-incidente (postmortems) e melhorias contínuas de confiabilidade.
  • Operar serviços de plataforma como Redis e Apache Solr com foco em disponibilidade, estabilidade, observabilidade e resposta a incidentes.
  • Gerenciar segredos e credenciais com Azure Key Vault e AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Operar registries de contêiner (ACR/ECR) e rotinas de imagens Docker (pull/push, credenciais e políticas).


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de produção com Azure e AWS.
  • Kubernetes (AKS e/ou EKS) e Docker.
  • GitOps com Argo CD.
  • CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions (YAML).
  • Infraestrutura como código com Terraform e deploy com Helm.
  • Base sólida de Linux e fundamentos de rede (DNS, HTTP/TLS, balanceamento/ingress) para troubleshooting.


Diferenciais

  • Estratégias de deploy (blue/green, canary, rolling).
  • APM e tracing distribuído (ex.: Datadog/New Relic, OpenTelemetry).
  • Práticas FinOps (governança e otimização de custos em cloud).
  • Experiência adicional com service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) e/ou gateways (APIM, API Gateway, Kong).
  • Práticas DevSecOps: scanning de vulnerabilidades (Trivy, Snyk), secrets rotation, políticas de compliance e hardening de pipelines.


Modelo de contratação

  • Regime: PJ ou CLT - CONTRATAÇÃO URGÊNTE
  • Senioridade: Sênior
  • Formato: Remoto ou híbrido

title: Pharmaceutical Retailers and Distributors (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specializing in business, healthcare, and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association, and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking for professionals in large pharmacy retailers and distributors for a paid consultancy section.


Qualifications:

  • Responsible for purchasing, procurement, or supply chain decisions within Consumer Healthcare retail and wholesale organizations
  • The purpose of this study is to understand the evolving landscape of trust, regulation, and reputation within the healthcare industry.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an online survey , lasting around 20 minutes.


Compensation package - BRL R$750 for 20 minutes online survey

title: DTC Video Editor (Health & Wellness)
description:
Company Description

We are a fast-growing, Shopify-based DTC health brand in the pain relief space, focused primarily on back pain and sciatica.

Our products are therapy-driven and positioned at the intersection of medical credibility and direct-response performance marketing.

We scale primarily through paid acquisition (Meta & Google), and long-form VSL creative (2–10+ minutes) is one of the core growth levers of our company.

Creative execution is not optional here. It directly impacts revenue.

We are now looking for a high-level Senior Video Editor who understands performance marketing and can execute long-form VSLs at a high standard.


Role Overview

You will be responsible for editing long-form VSLs (2–10+ minutes) and performance-driven paid ads across multiple platforms.

You must understand:

• Retention pacing

• Direct-response storytelling

• Visual hierarchy

• Conversion psychology

• Editing for watch time and sales, not just aesthetics

You will work directly with leadership and creative direction to turn scripts into high-performing acquisition assets.


Minimum Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

  • 3–5+ years of professional video editing experience
  • Proven experience editing long-form VSLs (portfolio required)
  • Experience editing paid direct-response ads for DTC brands
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Strong proficiency in After Effects (or equivalent for motion graphics)
  • Deep understanding of retention-based pacing and performance editing
  • Ability to follow detailed creative briefs precisely
  • Ability to take feedback quickly and iterate without ego
  • High attention to detail and high production standards

Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.


Technical Skills Required

You must be able to execute:

  • Long-form VSL editing (5–10+ minutes, narrative-driven)
  • Motion graphics overlays
  • Animated callouts and dynamic visual highlights
  • Anatomical overlays (not developed from scratch) and concept-explainer visual effects
  • Product-focused motion elements (outlines, glow effects, benefit visualizations)
  • Pain-point animations (ex: radiating nerve pain)
  • Clean subtitle systems and visual retention elements
  • Seamless integration of b-roll, testimonials, AI voiceovers, and UGC content

You should understand how to visually reinforce claims and concepts without making content look exaggerated or gimmicky.


Bonus Points

  • Experience editing in health, wellness, or medical-adjacent niches
  • Experience with high-spend DTC brands
  • Experience collaborating closely with copywriters and creative strategists
  • Understanding of awareness levels and performance angles
  • Familiarity with Slack, Notion, Frame.io workflows


What You'll Be Doing

  • Edit long-form VSLs used as primary acquisition creatives
  • Edit short and mid-length paid ads derived from VSL content
  • Add motion graphics and anatomical overlays to enhance clarity and perceived efficacy
  • Translate scripts into visually engaging, high-retention video
  • Maintain brand consistency across all edits
  • Iterate based on performance data and feedback
  • Deliver assets reliably and on schedule

We move quickly and expect tight execution.


Who Is This Role For?

  • An editor who thinks beyond cutting clips
  • Someone who understands that editing impacts profitability
  • Someone who takes ownership
  • Someone who wants to build high-level performance skills
  • Someone who wants their work to directly impact scaling

This is not for beginners.

This is not for cinematic YouTube vlog editors.

This is for performance-driven editors.


Compensation & Structure

  • $2,000–$3,000 USD per month (based on experience)
  • Performance-based bonus
  • Full-time (40 hours per week)
  • Fully remote
  • Long-term growth potential


Application Process

To apply, send:

  • Your resume
  • Your portfolio (VSL examples required)
  • A short paragraph explaining your experience with performance-driven editing


If you are an experienced VSL editor who understands direct response and can execute at a high level, we want to see your work.


We are hiring immediately.

title: Exchange Administrator
description:
About the Role:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
  • Create, review, and automate processes using PowerShell to increase efficiency and operational control.
  • Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, system migrations, and upgrades.
  • Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with Office 365, focusing on identity administration, licensing, and end-user support.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Active Directory, including DNS, Group Policies (GPOs), and authentication.
  • Advanced PowerShell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
  • Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Availability to work under a contractor model.


Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft certifications related to the responsibilities of the role.
  • AWS experience is a plus.

title: Data Governance Architect
description:
N-iX is a global software development company founded in 2002, connecting over 2,400+ tech professionals across 40+ countries. We deliver innovative technology solutions in cloud computing, data analytics, AI, embedded software,IoT, and more to global industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Join us to create technology that drives real change for businesses and people across the world.

The Data Governance Architect will be responsible for creating and executing a cross-functional enterprise data program that supports overlapping data needs across tax, finance, and operations. This role requires strong leadership, deep hands-on technical skills (ETL, data modeling, SQL, MDM), and the ability to leverage platforms like Databricks for enterprise data solutions. A critical aspect is acting as a liaison with key business leaders to ensure data initiatives directly drive business value and compliance. Working hours: US business hours till 4 PM ET.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute a forward-thinking data governance strategy and roadmap. Build a scalable, adaptive framework that ensures compliance while facilitating the adoption of AI and GenAI technologies.
  • Lead the end-to-end development of enterprise ontologies and knowledge graphs, including schema design, reasoning rules, and alignment. Create scalable semantic models using RDF/OWL/SPARQL .
  • Integrate structured and unstructured sources into the semantic layer through schema mapping and harmonization. Conduct ontology validations, entity reconciliation, and SPARQL-based quality checks.
  • Oversee data cataloging, provenance, master data management (MDM), and metadata management. Establish standards for versioning control and change management.
  • Facilitate cross-departmental initiatives to establish a common data language. Provide insights on data investments and promote best practices across technical and functional teams.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent.
  • 10+ years in data management/governance with a proven record in leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in ontology engineering and knowledge graph development . Advanced proficiency in RDF, OWL, and SPARQL
  • Practical experience with Stardog, Metaphacts, or GraphDB
  • Proficiency in platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Topbraid EDG, Erwin, or LeanIX.
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with Python for automation.
  • Strong understanding of integrating relational, NoSQL, and semi-structured data. Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred).
  • Demonstrated success in transforming data practices within large, complex organizations and leading cross-functional teams.


Will be a plus:

  • Experience with reasoning engines, inference rules, and schema harmonization.
  • Familiarity with Google Knowledge Graph tools (Schema Tool, Critique, Cider).
  • Domain modeling experience in cloud infrastructure, software, or asset management.
  • Certifications in Azure or semantic technologies (Stardog, Metaphacts).



We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits

*not applicable for freelancers

title: Wiper
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give an unique development opportunity for our seafarers. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.


This job opportunity is for an Wiper to one of our foreign-flagged Shuttle Tankers with a 42x42 shift and international crew. We are looking for qualified and committed professionals to join our team.


Requirements:

- Bridge watch (Rule III/4)

- Tank low.g. Oil (EBPQ) V/1

- Security duties training (EFNT/EBCP) VI/6

- CIR

- Passport

- Yellow fever vaccine

- 2nd Dose COVID-19 (ConectSUS)

- Advanced English


Benefits:

-Food voucher

-Health plan extended to dependents, free of charge

-Life insurance, free of charge

-Boarding and disembarking assistance

-Double food voucher in December

-Wellhub membership: Gold+ plan 100% covered by the company


Note: All logistics are the responsibility of KNOT, regardless of your state of residence.


If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals and offers development opportunities, apply with us.


All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give an unique development opportunity for our seafarers. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.


This job opportunity is for an Wiper to one of our foreign-flagged Shuttle Tankers with a 42x42 shift and international crew. We are looking for qualified and committed professionals to join our team.


Requirements:

- Bridge watch (Rule III/4)

- Tank low.g. Oil (EBPQ) V/1

- Security duties training (EFNT/EBCP) VI/6

- CIR

- Passport

- Yellow fever vaccine

- 2nd Dose COVID-19 (ConectSUS)

- Advanced English


Benefits:

-Food voucher

-Health plan extended to dependents, free of charge

-Life insurance, free of charge

-Boarding and disembarking assistance

-Double food voucher in December

-Wellhub membership: Gold+ plan 100% covered by the company


Note: All logistics are the responsibility of KNOT, regardless of your state of residence.


If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals and offers development opportunities, apply with us.


All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: React Native Developer
description:
Our Client is one of largest TV providers in North America and we are searching for a Senior Software Developer to join our team. The project focuses on developing mobile application for video streaming platform.


Responsibilities:

  • You will be implementing new features and enhancing existing functionalities on client applications to support streaming video products. This includes estimation, design, development, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with other software engineers, product managers, and architects in a cross functional environment to ensure functions and performance meet customer requirements in a cost effective and maintainable way.
  • Provide on-call support including monitoring, triaging and resolving production issues


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Proficient in JavaScript and React Native mobile app development (5+ years) as well as at least one of the following: Java/Kotlin or Obj-C/Swift
  • Streaming mobile app development experience with iOS/Android and TV Platforms
  • Strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams
  • Experience with agile development
  • Good verbal/written communications skills

title: UX/UI Design E-commerce - Figma
description:
About the Company

We are a Shopify Premier Agency with an eight-year history of delivering e-commerce solutions for established consumer brands. Our focus is on creating high-performing digital storefronts by balancing aesthetic quality with technical performance. We are currently expanding our design department to work closely with our established engineering team.


The Role

We are seeking a UI/UX Designer who specializes in e-commerce. This role involves designing end-to-end shopping experiences that are both visually compelling and technically viable. You will be responsible for translating brand requirements into functional interfaces, ensuring that every design decision supports the broader goal of driving conversions and enhancing user experience.


Key Responsibilities
  • E-Commerce Design: Develop comprehensive UI/UX solutions for product pages, checkout flows, and landing pages tailored for Shopify-based brands.
  • Technical Collaboration: Partner with the engineering team throughout the project lifecycle to ensure designs are implemented accurately and efficiently.
  • Trend Analysis: Stay current with evolving e-commerce trends and UX best practices to provide informed recommendations to clients.
  • Prototyping & Handoff: Manage the transition from design to development, providing clear documentation and interactive prototypes.

    • Required Qualifications
    • E-Commerce Experience: A portfolio demonstrating previous work on websites that sell products, with a clear understanding of retail-specific UX.
    • Figma Proficiency: Expert-level knowledge of Figma is mandatory, including the use of components, auto-layout, and prototyping tools.
    • Bi-Lingual - Spanish and English
    • Technical Literacy: Familiarity with the product and engineering lifecycle; you should understand how design decisions impact front-end development.
    • U.S. Timezone Alignment: Ability to work standard U.S. business hours to facilitate real-time collaboration with the team and clients.

    • Benefits
    • Professional Development: We provide paid training and professional classes to support your career growth.
    • Paid Time Off: Comprehensive PTO policy to ensure work-life balance.
    • Stability: Join a structured team with nearly a decade of experience in the Shopify ecosystem.

title: Data Analyst
description:
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.


Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 23 sequential quarters of growth with $422.5M in Q3 FY26 revenue, up 4.0% Q-o-Q and 17.3% Y-o-Y growth. Our 26,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We won the 2025 ISG Star of Excellence™ Award for AI and Data Excellence and were named a Leader in the Everest Group Talent Readiness for Next-generation Data, Analytics and AI Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2025.


Our company fosters a values-driven and people-centric work environment that enables our employees to:


  • Accelerate growth, both professionally and personally
  • Impact the world in powerful, positive ways, using the latest technologies
  • Enjoy collaborative innovation, with diversity and work-life wellbeing at the core
  • Unlock global opportunities to work and learn with the industry’s best


Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers


About Position:


Role: Data Analyst

Location: Remote Brazil

Job Type: Full Time Employment


What You'll Do:

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics engineering
  • Must Have CRO experience.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL
  • Hands on experience building with Power BI or similar BI tools
  • Strong understanding of data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) and data architecture
  • Proficiency in hypothesis testing and data quality analysis
  • Hands on experience converting business rules into KPI/metrics using SQL and Python
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience collaborating with product, engineering, and architecture roles
  • Understanding of AI/ML lifecycles and feature pipelines


We are looking for a Data Analyst with clinical trials / CRO exposure, who has worked on:

  • Clinical trial data (study, site, investigator, patient enrollment)
  • Trial operations reporting
  • Study progress, milestones, KPIs
  • Data from CTMS / EDC / CDMS or similar clinical systems
  • Dashboards & reports for clinical teams (Power BI / Tableau / SQL)


Typical reports include:

  • Study & site performance
  • Enrollment trends
  • Protocol deviations
  • Trial timelines
  • Study‑level cost & budget tracking (optional)


Expertise You'll Bring:

  • Proficiency in data governance, lineage, metadata management, parameterization, and versioning
  • Exposure to regulated environments (GxP, ISO) and validation requirements
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environment


Benefits:


  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly promotion cycles and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents


Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:


Persistent Ltd. is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.


We offer hybrid work options and flexible working hours to accommodate various needs and preferences.

Our office is equipped with accessible facilities, including adjustable workstations, ergonomic chairs, and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.

If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive.


Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent


For more detail, please contact – Rahul Sharma ()

title: Pessoa Engenheira de IA
description:
Descrição da vaga

A posição de AI exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.
  • Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI).
  • Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente.
  • Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas.
  • Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções.
  • Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas.
  • Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT).
  • Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines.
  • Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas).
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas.
  • Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT).
  • Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines.
  • Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas).
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

Vaga presencial para Curitiba, centro.

title: Gerente de proyecto regional de pagos
description:
El candidato seleccionado deberá:


Liderar la gestión integral del proyecto de alistamiento y preparación de los países miembros del FLAR para su eventual participación en un piloto de interconexión de sistemas de pagos inmediatos, asegurando el cumplimiento de los hitos definidos, la adecuada coordinación con los bancos centrales participantes y otros actores relevantes; así como la correcta articulación de los componentes técnicos, regulatorios, operativos y de flujo comercial.


El candidato seleccionado deberá:


  • Diseñar e implementar el plan de trabajo detallado del proyecto, traduciendo los objetivos estratégicos en planes ejecutables, realizando seguimiento periódico al avance, riesgos, dependencias y posibles desviaciones, y proponiendo acciones correctivas y estrategias de mitigación cuando sea necesario.
  • Conformar y coordinar el equipo de trabajo del proyecto en articulación con las instancias internas relevantes, bancos centrales participantes, contrapartes técnicas y otras institucionales, incluyendo la facilitación de ejercicios de diagnóstico o autoevaluación.
  • Preparar reportes ejecutivos periódicos para la alta dirección; desarrollar presentaciones para comités, mesas regionales y eventos estratégicos, y documentar las decisiones clave, lecciones aprendidas y avances del proyecto.
  • Sistematizar los aprendizajes y buenas prácticas del proyecto para generar insumos técnicos y conceptuales para la Plataforma C3 del FLAR, difundiendo y socializando los resultados en espacios como workshops, webinars y foros cuando sea solicitado.


Requisitos


  • Profesional en economía, ingeniería, administración, finanzas, sistemas, derecho, relaciones internacionales o áreas afines. Deseable, posgrado en gestión de proyectos, innovación, sistemas financieros o transformación digital.
  • Experiencia mínima comprobada de 5 años en la gestión de proyectos complejos y multiactor, preferiblemente en proyectos relacionados con sistemas de pagos, infraestructura financiera o en entornos de bancos centrales, entidades públicas u organismos internacionales, y certificación en gestión de proyectos (PMP® o PRINCE2® Practitioner).
  • Niveles de idiomas mínimos requeridos: español C1, inglés C1, portugués C1.


Conocimientos técnicos

  • Dominio de metodologías formales de gestión de proyectos (PMI, PRINCE2 o enfoques híbridos)
  • Experiencia en el uso de herramientas de planificación y seguimiento (MS Project u otras equivalentes),
  • Conocimiento de sistemas de pagos, pagos inmediatos y/o infraestructura financiera
  • Conocimiento y uso estratégico de herramientas de inteligencia artificial orientado a mejorar la planificación, seguimiento, análisis y reporte del proyecto.


Tipo de contratación


Prestación de servicios, a un (1) año.



Si cumples con los requerimientos del perfil envíanos tu hoja de vida al correo electrónico .


Cierre de la convocatoria el 8 de marzo de 2026.

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, CloudWatch), Angular (v19 or similar), RxJS / Observables, MyBatis and Liquibase.
  • Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Hoje temos 6 centros de distribuições localizados estrategicamente no Brasil, presença na Argentina e México, com meta de expandir nossa participação no mercado da América Latina e representamos cerca de 400 fornecedores globais.


Para mais informações, visite


Na Química Anastácio, acreditamos que equipes diversas constroem soluções mais inovadoras e sustentáveis.

Nosso compromisso com a diversidade vai além do discurso: promovemos um ambiente onde todas as pessoas são respeitadas, valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer.

Temos orgulho dos nossos squads de diversidade — Gênero, Étnico-Racial, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, PCDs e Parentalidade — que atuam ativamente para tornar nossa cultura mais inclusiva e representativa.

Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, acolhedor e diverso , e buscamos constantemente ampliar a representatividade em nossos times. Incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes histórias, trajetórias e experiências. #VEMSERANASTACIO


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Assistência ao negociador e gestor de compras da área;
  • Realizar cotação de material produtivo importado e nacional;
  • Prospectar e homologar novos fornecedores e produtos;
  • Simulação de custo de nacionalização;
  • Atualização do price index;
  • Apoio e follow-up de documentos aos fornecedores;
  • Programação de entrega e grade de recebimento;
  • Emissão de pedido de compra e análise de performance de fornecedor;
  • Cadastros internos;
  • Tratativas de não conformidades e debit notes;
  • Apoio nas tratativas com as áreas de suporte e de interface.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração com ênfase em Comércio Exterior, Comércio Exterior, Química, Engenharia Química, Relações Internacionais e outros correlatos;
  • Desejável conhecimento com sistema Protheus TOTVS;
  • Inglês avançado.


Local de trabalho : Pinheiros, São Paulo - SP

Modelo de trabalho : Híbrido sendo 3x presenciais na semana

Horário de trabalho : Segunda à sexta-feira das 8h00 às 17h45

title: DTC Video Editor (Health & Wellness)
description:
Company Description

We are a fast-growing, Shopify-based DTC health brand in the pain relief space, focused primarily on back pain and sciatica.

Our products are therapy-driven and positioned at the intersection of medical credibility and direct-response performance marketing.

We scale primarily through paid acquisition (Meta & Google), and long-form VSL creative (2–10+ minutes) is one of the core growth levers of our company.

Creative execution is not optional here. It directly impacts revenue.

We are now looking for a high-level Senior Video Editor who understands performance marketing and can execute long-form VSLs at a high standard.


Role Overview

You will be responsible for editing long-form VSLs (2–10+ minutes) and performance-driven paid ads across multiple platforms.

You must understand:

• Retention pacing

• Direct-response storytelling

• Visual hierarchy

• Conversion psychology

• Editing for watch time and sales, not just aesthetics

You will work directly with leadership and creative direction to turn scripts into high-performing acquisition assets.


Minimum Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

  • 3–5+ years of professional video editing experience
  • Proven experience editing long-form VSLs (portfolio required)
  • Experience editing paid direct-response ads for DTC brands
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Strong proficiency in After Effects (or equivalent for motion graphics)
  • Deep understanding of retention-based pacing and performance editing
  • Ability to follow detailed creative briefs precisely
  • Ability to take feedback quickly and iterate without ego
  • High attention to detail and high production standards

Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.


Technical Skills Required

You must be able to execute:

  • Long-form VSL editing (5–10+ minutes, narrative-driven)
  • Motion graphics overlays
  • Animated callouts and dynamic visual highlights
  • Anatomical overlays (not developed from scratch) and concept-explainer visual effects
  • Product-focused motion elements (outlines, glow effects, benefit visualizations)
  • Pain-point animations (ex: radiating nerve pain)
  • Clean subtitle systems and visual retention elements
  • Seamless integration of b-roll, testimonials, AI voiceovers, and UGC content

You should understand how to visually reinforce claims and concepts without making content look exaggerated or gimmicky.


Bonus Points

  • Experience editing in health, wellness, or medical-adjacent niches
  • Experience with high-spend DTC brands
  • Experience collaborating closely with copywriters and creative strategists
  • Understanding of awareness levels and performance angles
  • Familiarity with Slack, Notion, Frame.io workflows


What You'll Be Doing

  • Edit long-form VSLs used as primary acquisition creatives
  • Edit short and mid-length paid ads derived from VSL content
  • Add motion graphics and anatomical overlays to enhance clarity and perceived efficacy
  • Translate scripts into visually engaging, high-retention video
  • Maintain brand consistency across all edits
  • Iterate based on performance data and feedback
  • Deliver assets reliably and on schedule

We move quickly and expect tight execution.


Who Is This Role For?

  • An editor who thinks beyond cutting clips
  • Someone who understands that editing impacts profitability
  • Someone who takes ownership
  • Someone who wants to build high-level performance skills
  • Someone who wants their work to directly impact scaling

This is not for beginners.

This is not for cinematic YouTube vlog editors.

This is for performance-driven editors.


Compensation & Structure

  • $2,000–$3,000 USD per month (based on experience)
  • Performance-based bonus
  • Full-time (40 hours per week)
  • Fully remote
  • Long-term growth potential


Application Process

To apply, send:

  • Your resume
  • Your portfolio (VSL examples required)
  • A short paragraph explaining your experience with performance-driven editing


If you are an experienced VSL editor who understands direct response and can execute at a high level, we want to see your work.


We are hiring immediately.

title: Data Governance Architect
description:
N-iX is a global software development company founded in 2002, connecting over 2,400+ tech professionals across 40+ countries. We deliver innovative technology solutions in cloud computing, data analytics, AI, embedded software,IoT, and more to global industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Join us to create technology that drives real change for businesses and people across the world.

The Data Governance Architect will be responsible for creating and executing a cross-functional enterprise data program that supports overlapping data needs across tax, finance, and operations. This role requires strong leadership, deep hands-on technical skills (ETL, data modeling, SQL, MDM), and the ability to leverage platforms like Databricks for enterprise data solutions. A critical aspect is acting as a liaison with key business leaders to ensure data initiatives directly drive business value and compliance. Working hours: US business hours till 4 PM ET.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute a forward-thinking data governance strategy and roadmap. Build a scalable, adaptive framework that ensures compliance while facilitating the adoption of AI and GenAI technologies.
  • Lead the end-to-end development of enterprise ontologies and knowledge graphs, including schema design, reasoning rules, and alignment. Create scalable semantic models using RDF/OWL/SPARQL .
  • Integrate structured and unstructured sources into the semantic layer through schema mapping and harmonization. Conduct ontology validations, entity reconciliation, and SPARQL-based quality checks.
  • Oversee data cataloging, provenance, master data management (MDM), and metadata management. Establish standards for versioning control and change management.
  • Facilitate cross-departmental initiatives to establish a common data language. Provide insights on data investments and promote best practices across technical and functional teams.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent.
  • 10+ years in data management/governance with a proven record in leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in ontology engineering and knowledge graph development . Advanced proficiency in RDF, OWL, and SPARQL
  • Practical experience with Stardog, Metaphacts, or GraphDB
  • Proficiency in platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Topbraid EDG, Erwin, or LeanIX.
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with Python for automation.
  • Strong understanding of integrating relational, NoSQL, and semi-structured data. Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred).
  • Demonstrated success in transforming data practices within large, complex organizations and leading cross-functional teams.


Will be a plus:

  • Experience with reasoning engines, inference rules, and schema harmonization.
  • Familiarity with Google Knowledge Graph tools (Schema Tool, Critique, Cider).
  • Domain modeling experience in cloud infrastructure, software, or asset management.
  • Certifications in Azure or semantic technologies (Stardog, Metaphacts).



We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits

*not applicable for freelancers

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!


Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.

title: Wiper
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give an unique development opportunity for our seafarers. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.


This job opportunity is for an Wiper to one of our foreign-flagged Shuttle Tankers with a 42x42 shift and international crew. We are looking for qualified and committed professionals to join our team.


Requirements:

- Bridge watch (Rule III/4)

- Tank low.g. Oil (EBPQ) V/1

- Security duties training (EFNT/EBCP) VI/6

- CIR

- Passport

- Yellow fever vaccine

- 2nd Dose COVID-19 (ConectSUS)

- Advanced English


Benefits:

-Food voucher

-Health plan extended to dependents, free of charge

-Life insurance, free of charge

-Boarding and disembarking assistance

-Double food voucher in December

-Wellhub membership: Gold+ plan 100% covered by the company


Note: All logistics are the responsibility of KNOT, regardless of your state of residence.


If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals and offers development opportunities, apply with us.


All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: React Native Developer
description:
Our Client is one of largest TV providers in North America and we are searching for a Senior Software Developer to join our team. The project focuses on developing mobile application for video streaming platform.


Responsibilities:

  • You will be implementing new features and enhancing existing functionalities on client applications to support streaming video products. This includes estimation, design, development, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with other software engineers, product managers, and architects in a cross functional environment to ensure functions and performance meet customer requirements in a cost effective and maintainable way.
  • Provide on-call support including monitoring, triaging and resolving production issues


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Proficient in JavaScript and React Native mobile app development (5+ years) as well as at least one of the following: Java/Kotlin or Obj-C/Swift
  • Streaming mobile app development experience with iOS/Android and TV Platforms
  • Strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams
  • Experience with agile development
  • Good verbal/written communications skills

title: UX/UI Design E-commerce - Figma
description:
About the Company

We are a Shopify Premier Agency with an eight-year history of delivering e-commerce solutions for established consumer brands. Our focus is on creating high-performing digital storefronts by balancing aesthetic quality with technical performance. We are currently expanding our design department to work closely with our established engineering team.


The Role

We are seeking a UI/UX Designer who specializes in e-commerce. This role involves designing end-to-end shopping experiences that are both visually compelling and technically viable. You will be responsible for translating brand requirements into functional interfaces, ensuring that every design decision supports the broader goal of driving conversions and enhancing user experience.


Key Responsibilities
  • E-Commerce Design: Develop comprehensive UI/UX solutions for product pages, checkout flows, and landing pages tailored for Shopify-based brands.
  • Technical Collaboration: Partner with the engineering team throughout the project lifecycle to ensure designs are implemented accurately and efficiently.
  • Trend Analysis: Stay current with evolving e-commerce trends and UX best practices to provide informed recommendations to clients.
  • Prototyping & Handoff: Manage the transition from design to development, providing clear documentation and interactive prototypes.

    • Required Qualifications
    • E-Commerce Experience: A portfolio demonstrating previous work on websites that sell products, with a clear understanding of retail-specific UX.
    • Figma Proficiency: Expert-level knowledge of Figma is mandatory, including the use of components, auto-layout, and prototyping tools.
    • Bi-Lingual - Spanish and English
    • Technical Literacy: Familiarity with the product and engineering lifecycle; you should understand how design decisions impact front-end development.
    • U.S. Timezone Alignment: Ability to work standard U.S. business hours to facilitate real-time collaboration with the team and clients.

    • Benefits
    • Professional Development: We provide paid training and professional classes to support your career growth.
    • Paid Time Off: Comprehensive PTO policy to ensure work-life balance.
    • Stability: Join a structured team with nearly a decade of experience in the Shopify ecosystem.

title: Data Analyst
description:
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.


Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 23 sequential quarters of growth with $422.5M in Q3 FY26 revenue, up 4.0% Q-o-Q and 17.3% Y-o-Y growth. Our 26,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We won the 2025 ISG Star of Excellence™ Award for AI and Data Excellence and were named a Leader in the Everest Group Talent Readiness for Next-generation Data, Analytics and AI Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2025.


Our company fosters a values-driven and people-centric work environment that enables our employees to:


  • Accelerate growth, both professionally and personally
  • Impact the world in powerful, positive ways, using the latest technologies
  • Enjoy collaborative innovation, with diversity and work-life wellbeing at the core
  • Unlock global opportunities to work and learn with the industry’s best


Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers


About Position:


Role: Data Analyst

Location: Remote Brazil

Job Type: Full Time Employment


What You'll Do:

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics engineering
  • Must Have CRO experience.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL
  • Hands on experience building with Power BI or similar BI tools
  • Strong understanding of data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) and data architecture
  • Proficiency in hypothesis testing and data quality analysis
  • Hands on experience converting business rules into KPI/metrics using SQL and Python
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience collaborating with product, engineering, and architecture roles
  • Understanding of AI/ML lifecycles and feature pipelines


We are looking for a Data Analyst with clinical trials / CRO exposure, who has worked on:

  • Clinical trial data (study, site, investigator, patient enrollment)
  • Trial operations reporting
  • Study progress, milestones, KPIs
  • Data from CTMS / EDC / CDMS or similar clinical systems
  • Dashboards & reports for clinical teams (Power BI / Tableau / SQL)


Typical reports include:

  • Study & site performance
  • Enrollment trends
  • Protocol deviations
  • Trial timelines
  • Study‑level cost & budget tracking (optional)


Expertise You'll Bring:

  • Proficiency in data governance, lineage, metadata management, parameterization, and versioning
  • Exposure to regulated environments (GxP, ISO) and validation requirements
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environment


Benefits:


  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly promotion cycles and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents


Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:


Persistent Ltd. is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.


We offer hybrid work options and flexible working hours to accommodate various needs and preferences.

Our office is equipped with accessible facilities, including adjustable workstations, ergonomic chairs, and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.

If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive.


Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent


For more detail, please contact – Rahul Sharma ()

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Customer Success (RH)
description:
Responsável por contribuir com o Sucesso do Cliente e os interesses do negócio com a solução e serviços adquiridos, para entregar uma melhor experiência de uso em todas as etapas da jornada na TOTVS.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Otimizar a experiência do cliente, ampliando a satisfação em cada ponto da Jornada, por meio do
  • acompanhamento de indicadores de sucesso e satisfação;
  • Coordenar a equipe sob sua responsabilidade para mobilizar e desdobrar a atuação dos times correlacionados, realizando a gestão no que tange a controle de ponto, férias, ausências, 1:1, feedbacks, dailys e ações de gestão de pessoas;
  • Participar de Reuniões de alinhamento entre as áreas (juntos aos demais coordenadores) para ajustar ou alinhar processos, priorizando em cenário de múltiplas demandas junto a liderança do time, conciliando as diferenças de opinião e estilos de forma positiva, com a escuta ativa em busca da melhor solução;
  • Dar visibilidade dos resultados da área, integrando os diversos departamentos da empresa para que haja o constante cumprimento de promessas feitas para o cliente, além de dar visibilidade dos resultados da área;
  • Atrair, desenvolver e inspirar os melhores TOTVERS dedicando tempo de qualidade a seu time;
  • Garantir a execução dos processos existentes, revisar, criar processos e/ou metodologias utilizados pela área, buscando a simplificação das atividades e ganho de eficiência;
  • Mobilizar as equipes TOTVS para que as oportunidades de melhoria e/ou eventuais problemas sejam endereçados e executados, por meio do compartilhamento de feedbacks de seus clientes com os times;
  • Ser a voz do cliente (VoC) nas reuniões/interações com outros times (produto, suporte, vendas,
  • implantação), trazendo a visão dos clientes nas estratégias das áreas.
  • Direcionar o líder na capacitação do time compartilhando boas práticas de atuação de CS, assim como contribuir com a visão de negócio e de mercado.
  • Orquestrar ações de organização, carteiras e segmentação dos clientes para acompanhamento dos Agentes de Sucesso.;
  • Estruturar, revisar e publicar as pesquisas de NPS para os grupos de trabalho envolvidos na gestão dos promotores, neutros e detratores por linha de produto;
  • Efetuar acompanhamento das EBRs, revisando e validando conteúdo, de forma a estabelecer
  • conjuntamente com o Agente de Sucesso, um Plano de Ação eventualmente definido para determinado cliente.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação: Superior completo. Desejável pós-graduação, especialização, MBA ou capacitação complementar na área de relacionamento com o cliente.

Conhecimentos específicos:

  • Marketing Digital - conceitual;
  • Familiaridade com o mercado de tecnologia, startups e/ou SaaS;
  • Técnicas de Negociação
  • Resolução de Problemas
  • Excel e Power Point - nível avançado
  • ITIL, Metodologias Ágeis, Design Thinking ou Gestão de Processos de Negócios - desejável
  • Regras de Negócio de acordo com o segmento de atuação (desejável);

Gestão de Pessoas;

  • Indicadores de CS e CX - nível avançado.

Idiomas:

  • Desejável inglês - nível intermediário


Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de IA
description:
Descrição da vaga

A posição de AI exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.
  • Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI).
  • Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente.
  • Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas.
  • Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções.
  • Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas.
  • Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT).
  • Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines.
  • Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas).
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

title: Gerente de proyecto regional de pagos
description:
El candidato seleccionado deberá:


Liderar la gestión integral del proyecto de alistamiento y preparación de los países miembros del FLAR para su eventual participación en un piloto de interconexión de sistemas de pagos inmediatos, asegurando el cumplimiento de los hitos definidos, la adecuada coordinación con los bancos centrales participantes y otros actores relevantes; así como la correcta articulación de los componentes técnicos, regulatorios, operativos y de flujo comercial.


El candidato seleccionado deberá:


  • Diseñar e implementar el plan de trabajo detallado del proyecto, traduciendo los objetivos estratégicos en planes ejecutables, realizando seguimiento periódico al avance, riesgos, dependencias y posibles desviaciones, y proponiendo acciones correctivas y estrategias de mitigación cuando sea necesario.
  • Conformar y coordinar el equipo de trabajo del proyecto en articulación con las instancias internas relevantes, bancos centrales participantes, contrapartes técnicas y otras institucionales, incluyendo la facilitación de ejercicios de diagnóstico o autoevaluación.
  • Preparar reportes ejecutivos periódicos para la alta dirección; desarrollar presentaciones para comités, mesas regionales y eventos estratégicos, y documentar las decisiones clave, lecciones aprendidas y avances del proyecto.
  • Sistematizar los aprendizajes y buenas prácticas del proyecto para generar insumos técnicos y conceptuales para la Plataforma C3 del FLAR, difundiendo y socializando los resultados en espacios como workshops, webinars y foros cuando sea solicitado.


Requisitos


  • Profesional en economía, ingeniería, administración, finanzas, sistemas, derecho, relaciones internacionales o áreas afines. Deseable, posgrado en gestión de proyectos, innovación, sistemas financieros o transformación digital.
  • Experiencia mínima comprobada de 5 años en la gestión de proyectos complejos y multiactor, preferiblemente en proyectos relacionados con sistemas de pagos, infraestructura financiera o en entornos de bancos centrales, entidades públicas u organismos internacionales, y certificación en gestión de proyectos (PMP® o PRINCE2® Practitioner).
  • Niveles de idiomas mínimos requeridos: español C1, inglés C1, portugués C1.


Conocimientos técnicos

  • Dominio de metodologías formales de gestión de proyectos (PMI, PRINCE2 o enfoques híbridos)
  • Experiencia en el uso de herramientas de planificación y seguimiento (MS Project u otras equivalentes),
  • Conocimiento de sistemas de pagos, pagos inmediatos y/o infraestructura financiera
  • Conocimiento y uso estratégico de herramientas de inteligencia artificial orientado a mejorar la planificación, seguimiento, análisis y reporte del proyecto.


Tipo de contratación


Prestación de servicios, a un (1) año.



Si cumples con los requerimientos del perfil envíanos tu hoja de vida al correo electrónico .


Cierre de la convocatoria el 8 de marzo de 2026.

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.

  • Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.


Additional Information

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: DTC Video Editor (Health & Wellness)
description:
Company Description

We are a fast-growing, Shopify-based DTC health brand in the pain relief space, focused primarily on back pain and sciatica.

Our products are therapy-driven and positioned at the intersection of medical credibility and direct-response performance marketing.

We scale primarily through paid acquisition (Meta & Google), and long-form VSL creative (2–10+ minutes) is one of the core growth levers of our company.

Creative execution is not optional here. It directly impacts revenue.

We are now looking for a high-level Senior Video Editor who understands performance marketing and can execute long-form VSLs at a high standard.


Role Overview

You will be responsible for editing long-form VSLs (2–10+ minutes) and performance-driven paid ads across multiple platforms.

You must understand:

• Retention pacing

• Direct-response storytelling

• Visual hierarchy

• Conversion psychology

• Editing for watch time and sales, not just aesthetics

You will work directly with leadership and creative direction to turn scripts into high-performing acquisition assets.


Minimum Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

  • 3–5+ years of professional video editing experience
  • Proven experience editing long-form VSLs (portfolio required)
  • Experience editing paid direct-response ads for DTC brands
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Strong proficiency in After Effects (or equivalent for motion graphics)
  • Deep understanding of retention-based pacing and performance editing
  • Ability to follow detailed creative briefs precisely
  • Ability to take feedback quickly and iterate without ego
  • High attention to detail and high production standards

Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.


Technical Skills Required

You must be able to execute:

  • Long-form VSL editing (5–10+ minutes, narrative-driven)
  • Motion graphics overlays
  • Animated callouts and dynamic visual highlights
  • Anatomical overlays (not developed from scratch) and concept-explainer visual effects
  • Product-focused motion elements (outlines, glow effects, benefit visualizations)
  • Pain-point animations (ex: radiating nerve pain)
  • Clean subtitle systems and visual retention elements
  • Seamless integration of b-roll, testimonials, AI voiceovers, and UGC content

You should understand how to visually reinforce claims and concepts without making content look exaggerated or gimmicky.


Bonus Points

  • Experience editing in health, wellness, or medical-adjacent niches
  • Experience with high-spend DTC brands
  • Experience collaborating closely with copywriters and creative strategists
  • Understanding of awareness levels and performance angles
  • Familiarity with Slack, Notion, Frame.io workflows


What You'll Be Doing

  • Edit long-form VSLs used as primary acquisition creatives
  • Edit short and mid-length paid ads derived from VSL content
  • Add motion graphics and anatomical overlays to enhance clarity and perceived efficacy
  • Translate scripts into visually engaging, high-retention video
  • Maintain brand consistency across all edits
  • Iterate based on performance data and feedback

title: Exchange Administrator
description:
About the Role:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
  • Create, review, and automate processes using PowerShell to increase efficiency and operational control.
  • Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, system migrations, and upgrades.
  • Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with Office 365, focusing on identity administration, licensing, and end-user support.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Active Directory, including DNS, Group Policies (GPOs), and authentication.
  • Advanced PowerShell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
  • Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Availability to work under a contractor model.


Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft certifications related to the responsibilities of the role.
  • AWS experience is a plus.

title: Data Governance Architect
description:
N-iX is a global software development company founded in 2002, connecting over 2,400+ tech professionals across 40+ countries. We deliver innovative technology solutions in cloud computing, data analytics, AI, embedded software,IoT, and more to global industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Join us to create technology that drives real change for businesses and people across the world.

The Data Governance Architect will be responsible for creating and executing a cross-functional enterprise data program that supports overlapping data needs across tax, finance, and operations. This role requires strong leadership, deep hands-on technical skills (ETL, data modeling, SQL, MDM), and the ability to leverage platforms like Databricks for enterprise data solutions. A critical aspect is acting as a liaison with key business leaders to ensure data initiatives directly drive business value and compliance. Working hours: US business hours till 4 PM ET.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute a forward-thinking data governance strategy and roadmap. Build a scalable, adaptive framework that ensures compliance while facilitating the adoption of AI and GenAI technologies.
  • Lead the end-to-end development of enterprise ontologies and knowledge graphs, including schema design, reasoning rules, and alignment. Create scalable semantic models using RDF/OWL/SPARQL .
  • Integrate structured and unstructured sources into the semantic layer through schema mapping and harmonization. Conduct ontology validations, entity reconciliation, and SPARQL-based quality checks.
  • Oversee data cataloging, provenance, master data management (MDM), and metadata management. Establish standards for versioning control and change management.
  • Facilitate cross-departmental initiatives to establish a common data language. Provide insights on data investments and promote best practices across technical and functional teams.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent.
  • 10+ years in data management/governance with a proven record in leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in ontology engineering and knowledge graph development . Advanced proficiency in RDF, OWL, and SPARQL
  • Practical experience with Stardog, Metaphacts, or GraphDB
  • Proficiency in platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Topbraid EDG, Erwin, or LeanIX.
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with Python for automation.
  • Strong understanding of integrating relational, NoSQL, and semi-structured data. Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred).
  • Demonstrated success in transforming data practices within large, complex organizations and leading cross-functional teams.


Will be a plus:

  • Experience with reasoning engines, inference rules, and schema harmonization.
  • Familiarity with Google Knowledge Graph tools (Schema Tool, Critique, Cider).
  • Domain modeling experience in cloud infrastructure, software, or asset management.
  • Certifications in Azure or semantic technologies (Stardog, Metaphacts).



We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits

*not applicable for freelancers
